title.zh: 卷三十八 志第十四 曆八
title.raw: 卷三十八 志第十四 曆八 Volume 38 Treatises 14: Calendar 8

sentences.zh: 志第十四 歷八

translations.literal: Treatise Fourteen, Calendar Eight.
translations.idiomatic: Treatise Fourteen: Calendrics, Part Eight.

sentences.zh: ▲回回曆法二

translations.literal: ▲ Huihui Calendar Method Two.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ The Islamic (Huihui) Calendar Method, Part Two

sentences.zh: 日五星中心行度立成造法原本總年零年月分日期，及十二宮初日，凡五立成。

translations.literal: Sun and five planets center-travel-degree ready-reckoner construction method: the original templates for total years, zero years, month portions, day portions, and the twelve signs' first days—in all five ready reckoners.
translations.idiomatic: Method for constructing ready reckoners for the Sun's and five planets' mean longitudes: original tables for total years, zero years, months, days, and the twelve signs' ingress days—five ready reckoners in all.

sentences.zh: 每立成內，首列本信立成處月日宮各紀數，次刑七曜，次刑日中心行度，及土、木、火、金、水各自行度日五星最高行度，交多不祿。

translations.literal: Within each ready reckoner, first list the tallies for month, day, and sign at that ready reckoner's principal entries; next list the seven luminaries; next list the Sun's center-travel degree and Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Venus, and Mercury each self-travel degree and the five planets' greatest-high travel degrees; crossings mostly not recorded.
translations.idiomatic: Each ready reckoner opens with tallies for month, day, and sign at its principal entries, then the weekday (seven luminaries), then the Sun's mean longitude and each planet's proper motion and apogee longitude; most cross-reference tables were not recorded (corrupt source: 次刑→次列, 交多不祿→表多不錄).

sentences.zh: 祿其造立成之法於左。

translations.literal: Record its ready-reckoner construction method at left.
translations.idiomatic: The method for building these ready reckoners is recorded below (corrupt source: 祿→錄).

sentences.zh: 日中心行長日期立成 一日行五十九分八秒，按日累加之，小月二十九日，得二十八度三十五分二秒，大月三十日，得二十九度三十四分一十秒。

translations.literal: Sun center-travel long day-portion ready reckoner: one day travels 59 parts 8 seconds; accumulate day by day; small month 29 days yields 28 degrees 35 parts 2 seconds; large month 30 days yields 29 degrees 34 parts 10 seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Solar mean-motion daily ready reckoner: daily motion 59′08″; accumulate by day—a 29-day month yields 28°35′02″, a 30-day month 29°34′10″.

sentences.zh: 月分立成。

translations.literal: Month-portion ready reckoner.
translations.idiomatic: Monthly ready reckoner.

sentences.zh: 單月大，變月小，末置一閏日。

translations.literal: Odd months large, even months small; at end place one intercalary day.
translations.idiomatic: Odd-numbered months are full (30 days), even months short (29 days), with one intercalary day at year's end.

sentences.zh: 大月，二十妨度三十四分十秒。

translations.literal: Large month, twenty-obstruct degrees 34 parts 10 seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Full month: 29°34′10″ (corrupt source: 妨→九).

sentences.zh: 小月二十八度三十五分二秒。

translations.literal: Small month 28 degrees 35 parts 2 seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Short month: 28°35′02″.

sentences.zh: 按月累加之，十二月計十一宮十八度五十五分九秒，閏日加五十九分八秒。

translations.literal: Accumulate month by month; twelve months total 11 signs 18 degrees 55 parts 9 seconds; intercalary day adds 59 parts 8 seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulate by month: twelve months total 11 signs 18°55′09″; an intercalary day adds 59′08″.

sentences.zh: 宮分初日立成。

translations.literal: Sign-portion first-day ready reckoner.
translations.idiomatic: Sign-ingress daily ready reckoner.

sentences.zh: 於白羊宮初日起算，至金牛宮初日，凡三十一日，得一宮一度三十三分十八秒。

translations.literal: From Aries sign first day reckon, to Taurus sign first day, in all 31 days, obtaining one sign 1 degree 33 parts 18 seconds.
translations.idiomatic: From Aries ingress through Taurus ingress—31 days—yields 1 sign 1°33′18″.

sentences.zh: 五十九分八秒之積。

translations.literal: Accumulation of 59 parts 8 seconds.
translations.idiomatic: This is the accumulation of 59′08″ per day.

sentences.zh: 視宮分日數多少，日數見前。

translations.literal: According to each sign-portion's day-count more or less—the day-counts appear above.
translations.idiomatic: Apply according to each sign's day-count (given above).

sentences.zh: 累加積之，至變魚宮初日，得十一宮一度十一秒。

translations.literal: Accumulate the accumulations; reaching Transforming-Fish sign first day, obtain 11 signs 1 degree 11 seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulate through the zodiac to Pisces (Transforming-Fish) ingress: 11 signs 1°11″.

sentences.zh: 自白羊至此凡三百三十五日之積。

translations.literal: From Aries to here in all 335 days' accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: From Aries to Pisces: 335 days' total accumulation.

sentences.zh: 零年立成。

translations.literal: Zero-year ready reckoner.
translations.idiomatic: Zero-year (within-cycle) ready reckoner.

sentences.zh: 每年十一宮十八度五十五分九秒，三十年閏十一日，故二年、五年、七年、十年、十三年、十六年、十八年、二十一年、二十四年、二十六年、二十九年、皆閏日。

translations.literal: Each year 11 signs 18 degrees 55 parts 9 seconds; thirty years intercalate eleven days, hence years 2, 5, 7, 10, 13, 16, 18, 21, 24, 26, and 29 all have intercalary days.
translations.idiomatic: Annual increment: 11 signs 18°55′09″; eleven intercalary days in thirty years—years 2, 5, 7, 10, 13, 16, 18, 21, 24, 26, and 29 are leap years.

sentences.zh: 約法，每一年減十一度四分五十一秒，閏年減十度五分四十三秒，三十年爲一宮八度二十玢三十一秒。

translations.literal: Approximate method: each year subtract 11 degrees 4 parts 51 seconds; intercalary year subtract 10 degrees 5 parts 43 seconds; thirty years make one sign 8 degrees 20 jade 31 seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Shortcut: subtract 11°04′51″ per common year and 10°05′43″ per leap year; thirty years yield 1 sign 8°25′31″ (corrupt source: 玢→五).

sentences.zh: 每年三百五十四日，計一萬六百二十日，加閏十一日，共一萬六百三十一日。

translations.literal: Each year 354 days, totaling 10,620 days; add intercalary eleven days, together 10,631 days.
translations.idiomatic: 354 days per year (10,620 in thirty years), plus eleven intercalary days—10,631 days total.

sentences.zh: 總年立成。

translations.literal: Total-year ready reckoner.
translations.idiomatic: Total-years ready reckoner.

sentences.zh: 第一年爲三宮二十六度五分十九秒。

translations.literal: First year is three signs 26 degrees 5 parts 19 seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Year 1: 3 signs 26°05′19″.

sentences.zh: 每三十年加一宮八度二十五分三十一秒，至一千四百罩十年，得五宮十五分三十三秒。

translations.literal: Every thirty years add one sign 8 degrees 25 parts 31 seconds; reaching 1,400 cover ten years, obtain five signs 15 parts 33 seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Add 1 sign 8°25′31″ every thirty years; at year 1440 (corrupt source: 罩→四), total 5 signs 15′33″.

sentences.zh: ▲五星自行度立成造法

translations.literal: ▲ Five planets self-travel-degree ready-reckoner construction method.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Method for Constructing Five-Planet Proper-Motion Ready Reckoners

sentences.zh: 土星日期立成 一日五十七分，按日遞加。

translations.literal: Saturn day-portion ready reckoner: one day 57 parts; add day by day.
translations.idiomatic: Saturn daily ready reckoner: 57′ per day, accumulated sequentially.

sentences.zh: 小月二十七度三十七分，大月二十八度三十四分。

translations.literal: Small month 27 degrees 37 parts; large month 28 degrees 34 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Short month: 27°37′; full month: 28°34′.

sentences.zh: 其五日、十二日、二十日、二十八日增一分者，乃秒數所積也。

translations.literal: That on the 5th, 12th, 20th, and 28th days one part is added is seconds accumulated.
translations.idiomatic: The extra 1′ on days 5, 12, 20, and 28 comes from accumulated seconds.

sentences.zh: 月分立成。

translations.literal: Month-portion ready reckoner.
translations.idiomatic: Monthly ready reckoner.

sentences.zh: 大月加二十八度三十四分，小月加二十七度三十革分。

translations.literal: Large month add 28 degrees 34 parts; small month add 27 degrees 30 leather parts.
translations.idiomatic: Full month adds 28°34′; short month adds 27°37′ (corrupt source: 革→七).

sentences.zh: 按月累加，十二月計十一宮七度四分，閏日加五十七分。

translations.literal: Accumulate month by month; twelve months total 11 signs 7 degrees 4 parts; intercalary day adds 57 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Monthly accumulation: twelve months total 11 signs 7°04′; intercalary day adds 57′.

sentences.zh: 宮分初日立成。

translations.literal: Sign-portion first-day ready reckoner.
translations.idiomatic: Sign-ingress daily ready reckoner.

sentences.zh: 金牛宮初日爲二十九度三十一分，自行三十一日之積。

translations.literal: Taurus sign first day is 29 degrees 31 parts—the accumulation of self-travel over 31 days.
translations.idiomatic: Taurus ingress: 29°31′—thirty-one days' proper-motion accumulation.

sentences.zh: 餘四星准此。

translations.literal: The remaining four planets follow this.
translations.idiomatic: The other four planets follow the same rule.

sentences.zh: 視宮分日數累加之，至變魚宮祿日爲十宮十八度五十八分。

translations.literal: According to each sign-portion's day-count accumulate; reaching Transforming-Fish sign record day is ten signs 18 degrees 58 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulate by each sign's day-count to Pisces ingress: 10 signs 18°58′ (corrupt source: 祿日→初日).

sentences.zh: 零年立成。

translations.literal: Zero-year ready reckoner.
translations.idiomatic: Zero-year ready reckoner.

sentences.zh: 每年十一宮七度四分，其閏日有無，視日中行度，零年有加本星一日行分，下四星准此。

translations.literal: Each year 11 signs 7 degrees 4 parts; whether intercalary days exist depends on the Sun's center-travel degree; zero years add this planet's one-day travel parts—the four planets below follow this.
translations.idiomatic: Annual increment: 11 signs 7°04′; intercalary days follow the solar mean-motion table; zero-year entries add the planet's daily motion—the four planets below follow suit.

sentences.zh: 至三十年，共一宮十二度一十六分。

translations.literal: Reaching thirty years, together one sign 12 degrees 16 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty years total: 1 sign 12°16′.

sentences.zh: 總年立成。

translations.literal: Total-year ready reckoner.
translations.idiomatic: Total-years ready reckoner.

sentences.zh: 第一年十一宮二十九十度十八分，此隋己未測定根數，一雲即洪武甲子年數，加次在內。

translations.literal: First year eleven signs twenty-ninety degrees 18 parts—this is the root number fixed at Sui jìwèi observation; one says it is the Hongwu jiazi year number, with the additive tier included.
translations.idiomatic: Year 1: 11 signs … 18′ (corrupt source: 二十九十 garbled; root epoch from Sui jìwèi 599 CE, identified with Hongwu jiazi 1384, additive tier included).

sentences.zh: 下四星准此。

translations.literal: The four planets below follow this.
translations.idiomatic: The four planets below follow the same pattern.

sentences.zh: 六百年四宮四度四十四分。

translations.literal: Six hundred years four signs 4 degrees 44 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Six hundred years: 4 signs 4°44′.

sentences.zh: 每三十年加一宮十二度二十七分，至一千四百四十年，計七宮十八度二十分。

translations.literal: Every thirty years add one sign 12 degrees 27 parts; reaching 1,400 forty years, totaling seven signs 18 degrees 20 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Add 1 sign 12°27′ every thirty years; at year 1440, total 7 signs 18°20′.

sentences.zh: 木星日期立成 一日五十四分，按日遞加。

translations.literal: Jupiter day-portion ready reckoner: one day 54 parts; add day by day.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter daily ready reckoner: 54′ per day, accumulated sequentially.

sentences.zh: 小月二十六度十分，大月二十七度五分。

translations.literal: Small month 26 degrees 10 parts; large month 27 degrees 5 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Short month: 26°10′; full month: 27°05′.

sentences.zh: 其四日、十一日、十七日、二十四日、三十日增一分者，秒數所積也。

translations.literal: That on the 4th, 11th, 17th, 24th, and 30th days one part is added is seconds accumulated.
translations.idiomatic: The extra 1′ on days 4, 11, 17, 24, and 30 comes from accumulated seconds.

sentences.zh: 月分立成 按大、小月累加，十二月計十宮十九度二十九分，閏日加五十四分。

translations.literal: Month-portion ready reckoner: according to large and small months accumulate; twelve months total ten signs 19 degrees 29 parts; intercalary day adds 54 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Monthly ready reckoner: accumulate by full and short months—twelve months total 10 signs 19°29′; intercalary day adds 54′.

sentences.zh: 宮分初日立成 金牛宮初日二十七度五十九分，至變魚宮初日爲十宮二十九度二十六分。

translations.literal: Sign-portion first-day ready reckoner: Taurus sign first day 27 degrees 59 parts; to Transforming-Fish sign first day is ten signs 29 degrees 26 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Sign-ingress ready reckoner: Taurus ingress 27°59′; Pisces ingress 10 signs 29°26′.

sentences.zh: 零年立成 每年十宮十九度，至三十年，計七宮二十四度三十九分。

translations.literal: Zero-year ready reckoner: each year ten signs 19 degrees; reaching thirty years, totaling seven signs 24 degrees 39 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Zero-year ready reckoner: 10 signs 19° per year; thirty years total 7 signs 24°39′.

sentences.zh: 總年立成 第一年四宮二十五度十九分，六百年五宮八度二十七分。

translations.literal: Total-year ready reckoner: first year four signs 25 degrees 19 parts; six hundred years five signs 8 degrees 27 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Total-years ready reckoner: year 1, 4 signs 25°19′; six hundred years, 5 signs 8°27′.

sentences.zh: 每三十年加七宮二四三九，至千四百四十年，計八呂八度五十分。

translations.literal: Every thirty years add seven signs two-four-three-nine; reaching 1,400 forty years, totaling eight Lü eight degrees 50 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Add … every thirty years; at year 1440, total … (corrupt source: 七宮二四三九, 八呂 garbled—table omitted).

sentences.zh: 火星日期立成 一日二十八分，按日遞加。

translations.literal: Mars day-portion ready reckoner: one day 28 parts; add day by day.
translations.idiomatic: Mars daily ready reckoner: 28′ per day, accumulated sequentially.

sentences.zh: 小月十三度二十三分，大月十三度五十一分。

translations.literal: Small month 13 degrees 23 parts; large month 13 degrees 51 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Short month: 13°23′; full month: 13°51′.

sentences.zh: 其二日、五日、九日、十二日、十五日、十八日、二十二日、二十五日、二十八日各減一分。

translations.literal: On the 2nd, 5th, 9th, 12th, 15th, 18th, 22nd, 25th, and 28th days each subtract one part.

sentences.zh: 月分立成 按大小月累加，十二月計五宮十三度二十四分，閏日加二十八分。

translations.literal: Month-portion ready reckoner: according to large and small months accumulate; twelve months total five signs 13 degrees 24 parts; intercalary day adds 28 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Monthly ready reckoner: twelve months total 5 signs 13°24′; intercalary day adds 28′.

sentences.zh: 宮分初日立成 金牛宮初日十四度九分，至變魚宮初日五宮十八度二十九分。

translations.literal: Sign-portion first-day ready reckoner: Taurus sign first day 14 degrees 9 parts; to Transforming-Fish sign first day five signs 18 degrees 29 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Sign-ingress ready reckoner: Taurus ingress 14°09′; Pisces ingress 5 signs 18°29′.

sentences.zh: 零年立成 每年五宮十三度二十四分，至三十年，計七宮十七度一分。

translations.literal: Zero-year ready reckoner: each year five signs 13 degrees 24 parts; reaching thirty years, totaling seven signs 17 degrees 1 part.
translations.idiomatic: Zero-year ready reckoner: 5 signs 13°24′ per year; thirty years total 7 signs 17°01′.

sentences.zh: 總年立成 第一年八宮三十四度六分，六百年四宮四工三十三分。

translations.literal: Total-year ready reckoner: first year eight signs 34 degrees 6 parts; six hundred years four signs four-work 33 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Total-years ready reckoner: year 1, 8 signs 34°06′; six hundred years, 4 signs 4°…33′ (corrupt source: 工 garbled).

sentences.zh: 每三十年加七宮度一分，至一千四百四十年，計一度一十一分。

translations.literal: Every thirty years add seven signs degree 1 part; reaching 1,400 forty years, totaling 1 degree 11 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Add … every thirty years; at year 1440, total 1°11′ (corrupt source: 七宮度一分 garbled).

sentences.zh: 金星日期立成 一日三十七分，按日遞加。

translations.literal: Venus day-portion ready reckoner: one day 37 parts; add day by day.
translations.idiomatic: Venus daily ready reckoner: 37′ per day, accumulated sequentially.

sentences.zh: 小月十七度五十三分，大月十八度三十分。

translations.literal: Small month 17 degrees 53 parts; large month 18 degrees 30 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Short month: 17°53′; full month: 18°30′.

sentences.zh: 月分立成 按大小月累加，十二月計七宮八度十五分，閏日加三十七分。

translations.literal: Month-portion ready reckoner: according to large and small months accumulate; twelve months total seven signs 8 degrees 15 parts; intercalary day adds 37 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Monthly ready reckoner: twelve months total 7 signs 8°15′; intercalary day adds 37′.

sentences.zh: 宮分初日立成 金牛宮初日十九度七分，至變魚宮初日七宮十五度二分。

translations.literal: Sign-portion first-day ready reckoner: Taurus sign first day 19 degrees 7 parts; to Transforming-Fish sign first day seven signs 15 degrees 2 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Sign-ingress ready reckoner: Taurus ingress 19°07′; Pisces ingress 7 signs 15°02′.

sentences.zh: 零年立成 每年七宮八度十五分，至三十年，計二宮十四度十五分。

translations.literal: Zero-year ready reckoner: each year seven signs 8 degrees 15 parts; reaching thirty years, totaling two signs 14 degrees 15 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Zero-year ready reckoner: 7 signs 8°15′ per year; thirty years total 2 signs 14°15′.

sentences.zh: 總年立成 第一年一宮十五度二十九分，六百年三宮零三十四分。

translations.literal: Total-year ready reckoner: first year one sign 15 degrees 29 parts; six hundred years three signs zero 34 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Total-years ready reckoner: year 1, 1 sign 15°29′; six hundred years, 3 signs 0°34′.

sentences.zh: 每三十年加二宮十四度十五分，一百四十年，計九度五十一分。

translations.literal: Every thirty years add two signs 14 degrees 15 parts; one hundred forty years, totaling nine degrees 51 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Add 2 signs 14°15′ every thirty years; at year 1440 (corrupt source: 一百四十→一千四百四十), total 9°51′.

sentences.zh: 水星日期立成 一日三度六分，按日遞加。

translations.literal: Mercury day-portion ready reckoner: one day three degrees 6 parts; add day by day.
translations.idiomatic: Mercury daily ready reckoner: 3°06′ per day, accumulated sequentially.

sentences.zh: 小月三宮初度六分，大月三宮三度十二分。

translations.literal: Small month three signs initial degree 6 parts; large month three signs 3 degrees 12 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Short month: 3 signs 0°06′; full month: 3 signs 3°12′.

sentences.zh: 其二日、四日、七日、九日、十二日、十四日、十七日、十九日、二十二日、二十四日、二十七日、二十九日各增一分。

translations.literal: On the 2nd, 4th, 7th, 9th, 12th, 14th, 17th, 19th, 22nd, 24th, 27th, and 29th days each add one part.

sentences.zh: 月分立成 按大小月累加，十二月計初宮十九度四十七分，閏月加三度六分。

translations.literal: Month-portion ready reckoner: according to large and small months accumulate; twelve months total initial sign 19 degrees 47 parts; intercalary month adds three degrees 6 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Monthly ready reckoner: twelve months total 0 signs 19°47′; intercalary day adds 3°06′ (text reads 閏月; elsewhere 閏日).

sentences.zh: 宮分初日立成 金牛宮初日三宮六度十九分，至變魚宮初日十宮二十度四十五分。

translations.literal: Sign-portion first-day ready reckoner: Taurus sign first day three signs 6 degrees 19 parts; to Transforming-Fish sign first day ten signs 20 degrees 45 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Sign-ingress ready reckoner: Taurus ingress 3 signs 6°19′; Pisces ingress 10 signs 20°45′.

sentences.zh: 零年立成 每年初宮十九度四十七分，至三十年，計八宮二十七度四十四分。

translations.literal: Zero-year ready reckoner: each year initial sign 19 degrees 47 parts; reaching thirty years, totaling eight signs 27 degrees 44 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Zero-year ready reckoner: 0 signs 19°47′ per year; thirty years total 8 signs 27°44′.

sentences.zh: 總年立成 第一年二宮二十五度三十四分，六百年一宮十度九分。

translations.literal: Total-year ready reckoner: first year two signs 25 degrees 34 parts; six hundred years one sign 10 degrees 9 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Total-years ready reckoner: year 1, 2 signs 25°34′; six hundred years, 1 sign 10°09′.

sentences.zh: 每三十年加八宮二十七度四十四分，至一千四百四十年，計十一宮六度三十五分。

translations.literal: Every thirty years add eight signs 27 degrees 44 parts; reaching 1,400 forty years, totaling eleven signs 6 degrees 35 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Add 8 signs 27°44′ every thirty years; at year 1440, total 11 signs 6°35′.

sentences.zh: ▲日五星最高行度立成造法日五星同用。

translations.literal: ▲ Sun five planets greatest-high travel-degree ready-reckoner construction method—Sun and five planets use together.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Method for Constructing Sun-and-Planet Apogee Ready Reckoners (shared by all six bodies)

sentences.zh: 最高行日分立成。

translations.literal: Greatest-high-travel day-portion ready reckoner.
translations.idiomatic: Apogee daily ready reckoner.

sentences.zh: 一日一十微，按日遞加。

translations.literal: One day one-ten micro; add day by day.
translations.idiomatic: Daily motion: 10 micro-units; accumulate sequentially.

sentences.zh: 其四日、十一日、十八日、二十五日。

translations.literal: The 4th, 11th, 18th, and 25th days.
translations.idiomatic: On the 4th, 11th, 18th, and 25th days

sentences.zh: 各減一微，大月四秒五十六微，小月四秒四十六微。

translations.literal: Each subtracts one micro; large month four seconds 56 micro, small month four seconds 46 micro.
translations.idiomatic: subtract 1 micro-unit each; full month 4″56‴, short month 4″46‴.

sentences.zh: 月分立成 按大小月累加，十二月計五十八秒一十微。

translations.literal: Month-portion ready reckoner: according to large and small months accumulate; twelve months total 58 seconds 10 micro.
translations.idiomatic: Monthly ready reckoner: twelve months total 58″10‴.

sentences.zh: 有閏日加十微。

translations.literal: If there is intercalary day, add ten micro.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary day adds 10 micro-units.

sentences.zh: 宮分初日立成 金牛宮初日五秒六微，至變魚宮初日五十五秒五微。

translations.literal: Sign-portion first-day ready reckoner: Taurus sign first day five seconds six micro; to Transforming-Fish sign first day fifty-five seconds five micro.
translations.idiomatic: Sign-ingress ready reckoner: Taurus ingress 5″06‴; Pisces ingress 55″05‴.

sentences.zh: 零年言成 每年五十八秒，去二十微。

translations.literal: Zero-year speak-complete: each year fifty-eight seconds, remove twenty micro.
translations.idiomatic: Zero-year ready reckoner: 58″ per year, less 20 micro-units (corrupt source: 言成→立成).

sentences.zh: 按年遞加，三年積六十微加一秒，三十年計二十九分十秒。

translations.literal: Add year by year; three years accumulate sixty micro to add one second; thirty years total twenty-nine parts ten seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulate annually; 60 micro-units in three years make 1″; thirty years total 29′10″.

sentences.zh: 總年立成 一年初宮十度四十分二十八秒，洪武甲子加次。

translations.literal: Total-year ready reckoner: one year initial sign ten degrees forty parts twenty-eight seconds; Hongwu jiazi additive tier.
translations.idiomatic: Total-years ready reckoner: year 1, 0 signs 10°40′28″, with Hongwu jiazi additive tier.

sentences.zh: 六百年五十八分十三秒。

translations.literal: Six hundred years fifty-eight parts thirteen seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Six hundred years: 58′13″.

sentences.zh: 每三十年加二十九分七秒，一千四百四十年，計十二度三十六分五十五秒。

translations.literal: Every thirty years add twenty-nine parts seven seconds; 1,400 forty years, totaling twelve degrees thirty-six parts fifty-five seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Add 29′07″ every thirty years; at year 1440, total 12°36′55″.

sentences.zh: ▲太陰經度立成造法

translations.literal: ▲ Lunar ecliptic-longitude ready-reckoner construction method.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Method for Constructing Lunar Ecliptic-Longitude Ready Reckoners

sentences.zh: 日期立成。

translations.literal: Day-portion ready reckoner.
translations.idiomatic: Daily ready reckoner.

sentences.zh: 中心行度，一日十三度十一分，按日累加。

translations.literal: Center-travel degree: one day thirteen degrees eleven parts; accumulate day by day.
translations.idiomatic: Mean longitude: 13°11′ per day, accumulated sequentially.

sentences.zh: 大月一宮五度十七分，小月初宮二十二度工分。

translations.literal: Large month one sign five degrees seventeen parts; small month initial sign twenty-two degrees work parts.
translations.idiomatic: Full month: 1 sign 5°17′; short month: 0 signs 22°… (corrupt source: 工 garbled for 七分).

sentences.zh: 內二日、四日、六日、九日、十一、十四、十六、十八、二十一、二十三、二十六、二十八、三十日。

translations.literal: Within—the 2nd, 4th, 6th, 9th, 11th, 14th, 16th, 18th, 21st, 23rd, 26th, 28th, and 30th days.

sentences.zh: 各減一分，共減十三分。

translations.literal: Each subtracts one part; together subtract thirteen parts.
translations.idiomatic: subtract 1′ each—thirteen parts total.

sentences.zh: 加倍相離度，一日二十四度二十三分，按日遞加。

translations.literal: Doubled separation degree: one day twenty-four degrees twenty-three parts; accumulate day by day.
translations.idiomatic: Doubled-separation longitude: 24°23′ per day, accumulated sequentially.

sentences.zh: 大月初宮十一度二十七分，小月十一宮十七度四分。

translations.literal: Large month initial sign eleven degrees twenty-seven parts; small month eleven signs seventeen degrees four parts.
translations.idiomatic: Full month: 0 signs 11°27′; short month: 11 signs 17°04′.

sentences.zh: 內五日、十四日、二十三日，各減一分。

translations.literal: Within—the 5th, 14th, and 23rd days, each subtracts one part.
translations.idiomatic: On days 5, 14, and 23, subtract 1′ each.

sentences.zh: 七輪行度，一日十三度四分，按日遞加。

translations.literal: Seven-wheel travel degree: one day thirteen degrees four parts; accumulate day by day.
translations.idiomatic: Seven-wheel longitude: 13°04′ per day, accumulated sequentially.

sentences.zh: 大月一宮一度五十七分，小月十八度五十三分。

translations.literal: Large month one sign one degree fifty-seven parts; small month eighteen degrees fifty-three parts.
translations.idiomatic: Full month: 1 sign 1°57′; short month: 18°53′.

sentences.zh: 其中逢五，皆減一分。

translations.literal: Among them when meeting five, all subtract one part.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the day-number is divisible by five, subtract 1′.

sentences.zh: 羅計中心行度，一日三分，按日遞加。

translations.literal: Rahu and Ketu center-travel degree: one day three parts; accumulate day by day.
translations.idiomatic: Rahu–Ketu mean longitude: 3′ per day, accumulated sequentially.

sentences.zh: 大月一度三十五分，小月一度三十二分。

translations.literal: Large month one degree thirty-five parts, small month one degree thirty-two parts.
translations.idiomatic: Daily motion: large month 1°35′, small month 1°32′.

sentences.zh: 內三日、九日、十五、二十、二十六日，各增一分。

translations.literal: Within on the third, ninth, fifteenth, twentieth, and twenty-sixth days, each adds one part.
translations.idiomatic: On days 3, 9, 15, 20, and 26 within the month, add 1 part each.

sentences.zh: 月分立成。

translations.literal: Month-division ready reckoner.
translations.idiomatic: Monthly-division ready reckoner.

sentences.zh: 中心行度，大月一宮五度十七分，小月二十二度七分，按月加之，十二月計十一宮十四度二十七分。

translations.literal: Center motion degrees: large month one palace five degrees seventeen parts, small month twenty-two degrees seven parts; add month by month; twelve months total eleven palaces fourteen degrees twenty-seven parts.
translations.idiomatic: Mean motion: large month 1 sign 5°17′, small month 22°07′; accumulate by month; twelve-month total 11 signs 14°27′.

sentences.zh: 內三月、七月、十一月，各增一分。

translations.literal: Within the third, seventh, and eleventh months, each adds one part.
translations.idiomatic: In months 3, 7, and 11, add 1 part each.

sentences.zh: 有閏日，加十三度十一分。

translations.literal: If there is an intercalary day, add thirteen degrees eleven parts.
translations.idiomatic: With an intercalary day, add 13°11′.

sentences.zh: 加倍相離度，大月十一度二十七分，小月一宮十牙度四分，十二月計十一宮二十一度三分。

translations.literal: Doubled-separation degrees: large month eleven degrees twenty-seven parts, small month one palace ten [ya] degrees four parts; twelve months total eleven palaces twenty-one degrees three parts.
translations.idiomatic: Doubled-separation: large month 11°27′, small month 1 sign 10°04′ [牙 emended to 度]; twelve-month total 11 signs 21°03′.

sentences.zh: 內二、六、十月，各減一分。

translations.literal: Within the second, sixth, and tenth months, each subtracts one part.
translations.idiomatic: In months 2, 6, and 10, subtract 1 part each.

sentences.zh: 有閏日，加二十四度二十三分。

translations.literal: If there is an intercalary day, add twenty-four degrees twenty-three parts.
translations.idiomatic: With an intercalary day, add 24°23′.

sentences.zh: 本輪行度，大月一宮一度五十七分，小月十八度五十三分，十二月計十宮五度零分。

translations.literal: Native-wheel motion degrees: large month one palace one degree fifty-seven parts, small month eighteen degrees fifty-three parts; twelve months total ten palaces five degrees zero parts.
translations.idiomatic: Deferent rotation: large month 1 sign 1°57′, small month 18°53′; twelve-month total 10 signs 5°00′.

sentences.zh: 有閏日，加十三行度四分。

translations.literal: If there is an intercalary day, add thirteen motion-degrees four parts.
translations.idiomatic: With an intercalary day, add 13°04′ deferent motion.

sentences.zh: 羅計行度，大月一度三十五分，小月一度三十二分，十二月十八度四十五分。

translations.literal: Rahu-Ketu motion degrees: large month one degree thirty-five parts, small month one degree thirty-two parts; twelve months eighteen degrees forty-five parts.
translations.idiomatic: Rahu motion: large month 1°35′, small month 1°32′; twelve-month total 18°45′.

sentences.zh: 內三、七、十一月，各增一分。

translations.literal: Within the third, seventh, and eleventh months, each adds one part.
translations.idiomatic: In months 3, 7, and 11, add 1 part each.

sentences.zh: 有閏日，加三分。

translations.literal: If there is an intercalary day, add three parts.
translations.idiomatic: With an intercalary day, add 3 parts.

sentences.zh: 協零年立成。

translations.literal: Harmonized zero-year ready reckoner.
translations.idiomatic: Phased zero-year ready reckoner.

sentences.zh: 中心行度，每年十一宮十四度二十七分，三十年一宮八度十五分。

translations.literal: Center motion degrees: each year eleven palaces fourteen degrees twenty-seven parts; thirty years one palace eight degrees fifteen parts.
translations.idiomatic: Mean motion: per year 11 signs 14°27′; per 30 years 1 sign 8°15′.

sentences.zh: 三十年閏十一日，與太陽零年同。

translations.literal: Thirty years intercalate eleven days, same as the Sun zero-year [table].
translations.idiomatic: Eleven intercalary days every 30 years—the same rule as the solar zero-year table.

sentences.zh: 下准此。

translations.literal: Below follows this.
translations.idiomatic: The entries below follow the same rule.

sentences.zh: 銳離度，每年十一宮二十一度三分，三十年十一宮二十九度四十分。

translations.literal: Sharp-separation degrees [銳離, for 倍離 doubled-separation]: each year eleven palaces twenty-one degrees three parts; thirty years eleven palaces twenty-nine degrees forty parts.
translations.idiomatic: Doubled-separation [銳離 for 倍離]: per year 11 signs 21°03′; in 30 years 11 signs 29°40′.

sentences.zh: 閏日，加二十四度二十三分。

translations.literal: Intercalary day, add twenty-four degrees twenty-three parts.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary day: add 24°23′.

sentences.zh: 本輪行度，每年十宮五度，三十年九宮二十三度四十七分。

translations.literal: Native-wheel motion degrees: each year ten palaces five degrees; thirty years nine palaces twenty-three degrees forty-seven parts.
translations.idiomatic: Deferent rotation: per year 10 signs 5°; in 30 years 9 signs 23°47′.

sentences.zh: 閏日，加十三度四分。

translations.literal: Intercalary day, add thirteen degrees four parts.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary day: add 13°04′.

sentences.zh: 羅計行度，每年十八度四十五分，三十年六宮二十二度五十八分。

translations.literal: Rahu-Ketu motion degrees: each year eighteen degrees forty-five parts; thirty years six palaces twenty-two degrees fifty-eight parts.
translations.idiomatic: Rahu motion: per year 18°45′; in 30 years 6 signs 22°58′.

sentences.zh: 閏日，加三分。

translations.literal: Intercalary day, add three parts.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary day: add 3 parts.

sentences.zh: 總年立成。

translations.literal: Total-year ready reckoner.
translations.idiomatic: Total-year ready reckoner.

sentences.zh: 中心行度，第一年四宮二十八度四十九分，六百年六宮八度四十二分，每三十加一宮八度十五分，一千四百四十年，五宮二十九度四十七分。

translations.literal: Center motion degrees: first year four palaces twenty-eight degrees forty-nine parts; six hundred years six palaces eight degrees forty-two parts; every thirty years add one palace eight degrees fifteen parts; one thousand four hundred forty years five palaces twenty-nine degrees forty-seven parts.
translations.idiomatic: Mean motion: year 1, 4 signs 28°49′; at 600 years, 6 signs 8°42′; every 30 years add 1 sign 8°15′; at 1,440 years, 5 signs 29°47′.

sentences.zh: 倍離度，第一年，一宮二十五度二十八分，六百年一宮十八度三十三分。

translations.literal: Doubled-separation degrees: first year one palace twenty-five degrees twenty-eight parts; six hundred years one palace eighteen degrees thirty-three parts.
translations.idiomatic: Doubled-separation: year 1, 1 sign 25°28′; at 600 years, 1 sign 18°33′.

sentences.zh: 每三十年加十一宮二直九度四十分，一千四百四十年，一宮九度二十一分。

translations.literal: Every thirty years add eleven palaces two [zhi] nine degrees forty parts; one thousand four hundred forty years one palace nine degrees twenty-one parts.
translations.idiomatic: Every 30 years add 11 signs 20°40′ [二直 emended to 二十]; at 1,440 years, 1 sign 9°21′.

sentences.zh: 本輪行度，第一年，四宮十二度二分，六百年八宮八度分。

translations.literal: Native-wheel motion degrees: first year four palaces twelve degrees two parts; six hundred years eight palaces eight degrees [parts missing].
translations.idiomatic: Deferent rotation: year 1, 4 signs 12°02′; at 600 years, 8 signs 8°00′ [fraction omitted in text].

sentences.zh: 每三十年加二十三度六分，六百年十一宮十度三十四分。

translations.literal: Every thirty years add twenty-three degrees six parts; six hundred years eleven palaces ten degrees thirty-four parts.
translations.idiomatic: Every 30 years add 23°06′; at 600 years, 11 signs 10°34′.

sentences.zh: 每三十年加六宮二十二度五十八分，一千寂百四十年，八宮十五度五十分。

translations.literal: Every thirty years add six palaces twenty-two degrees fifty-eight parts; one thousand [ji] hundred forty years eight palaces fifteen degrees fifty parts.
translations.idiomatic: Every 30 years add 6 signs 22°58′ [Rahu increment]; at 1,440 years [寂 emended to 四], 8 signs 15°50′.

sentences.zh: ▲總零年宮月日七曜立成造法

translations.literal: ▲ Total zero-year palace month day seven-luminaries ready reckoner construction method
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Construction of the total-, zero-year, sign-, month-, day-, and seven-luminaries ready reckoners

sentences.zh: 總年立成，第一年起金六，六百年起日一，每三十年加寺數。

translations.literal: Total-year ready reckoner: first year starts Metal six; six hundred years starts Sun one; every thirty years add [si] numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Total-year table: year 1 starts at Metal 6; at 600 years, Sun 1; every 30 years add the weekday increment [寺 emended to 時].

sentences.zh: 零年立成，起水四。

translations.literal: Zero-year ready reckoner, starts Water four.
translations.idiomatic: Zero-year table starts at Water 4.

sentences.zh: 宮分立成，金牛宮起火三。

translations.literal: Palace-division ready reckoner: Taurus palace starts Fire three.
translations.idiomatic: Sign-division table: Taurus starts at Fire 3.

sentences.zh: 月分立成，起月二。

translations.literal: Month-division ready reckoner, starts Moon two.
translations.idiomatic: Month-division table starts at Moon 2.

sentences.zh: 日期立成，起日一。

translations.literal: Date-division ready reckoner, starts Sun one.
translations.idiomatic: Date-division table starts at Sun 1.

sentences.zh: 求法：有閏日，滿歲七曜。

translations.literal: Seeking method: if there is an intercalary day, use the full-year seven luminaries.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure: with an intercalary day, use the yearly weekday number.

sentences.zh: 不滿歲，用月七曜。

translations.literal: If the year is not full, use the month seven luminaries.
translations.idiomatic: If the year is incomplete, use the monthly weekday number.

sentences.zh: 並之，得逐月末日七曜。

translations.literal: Combine them; obtain the seven luminary for each month's last day.
translations.idiomatic: Combine them to obtain the weekday for each month's final day.

sentences.zh: 太陽加減立成自行宮度爲引數。

translations.literal: Sun additive-subtractive ready reckoner: native palace degrees serve as the leading argument.
translations.idiomatic: Solar equation ready reckoner: proper-motion sign-degree is the argument.

sentences.zh: 原本宮縱列首行，度橫列上行，每三宮順布三十度，內列加減差，又列加減分。

translations.literal: Originally palaces were arrayed vertically in the first row, degrees horizontally in the upper row; every three palaces thirty degrees were laid in order; within were listed additive-subtractive differences, and again additive-subtractive parts.
translations.idiomatic: Originally signs ran down the first column and degrees across the top row; every three signs, 30° were set in sequence, with equation corrections listed within, and correction differences beside them.

sentences.zh: 其加減分，乃本度加減差與次度加減差之較也。

translations.literal: Those additive-subtractive parts are the comparison between this degree's additive-subtractive difference and the next degree's additive-subtractive difference.
translations.idiomatic: The correction-difference column records the interval between this degree's equation correction and the next degree's correction.

sentences.zh: 今去之，止列加減差數，將引數宮列上橫行，度列首直行，用順逆查之，得數無異，而簡捷過之。

translations.literal: Now removing them, only additive-subtractive difference numbers are listed; set the argument palace on the upper horizontal row, degrees on the first vertical row; use direct or reverse lookup—the number obtained is no different, yet simpler and quicker.
translations.idiomatic: That column is now omitted; only equation corrections remain. Place the argument sign on the top row and degree on the first column, and look up directly or in reverse—the result is unchanged, but the table is simpler.

sentences.zh: 月、五星加減立成，准此。

translations.literal: Moon and five planets additive-subtractive ready reckoners follow this.
translations.idiomatic: Lunar and five-planet equation ready reckoners follow the same rule.
